# D & D Fence

D & D Fence is a fence contractor serving Ennis and Waxahachie, TX, building and repairing privacy, cedar, chain link and wrought iron fences within about 25 miles of both towns.

## Business Information
- Owner: Austin Dunnahue
- Phone: (469) 321-7783
- Email: dunnahuea@gmail.com
- Address: Service-area business with no public street address. Serves Ennis, TX and Waxahachie, TX (Ellis County).
- Hours: Monday to Friday, 7 AM to 6 PM. Closed Saturday and Sunday.
- Service Area: Ennis, TX; Waxahachie, TX; and properties within about 25 miles of both
- Years in business: 6
- Google Business Profile: https://share.google/YeJ2GN1LFZbrmb75W

## Services
- Privacy Fence: privacy fence installation for residential backyards and property lines
- Cedar Fence: cedar wood fence installation for privacy, backyard and decorative fencing
- Chain Link: chain link fencing for yards, perimeters and security fencing
- Wrought Iron: wrought iron fencing for decorative, security and pool fence applications
- Fence Repair: repair of existing fences and gates
- Fence Installation: new fence and gate installation for residential and farm properties

## About
D & D Fence is a fence contractor owned by Austin Dunnahue. It builds and repairs fences around Ennis and Waxahachie in Ellis County, Texas, from backyard privacy fences to new fence and gate installation on residential and farm properties. Call (469) 321-7783 for availability and pricing.
